help_menu: Pick a category below to see what I can do. Every command also works without the leading /
help_admins: Admin commands • /pause — pause the stream • /resume — resume the stream • /skip — skip to the next track • /stop — end the stream • /seek [seconds] — jump forward • /seekback [seconds] — jump back • /reload — refresh the admin cache
help_auth: Auth commands Authorized members can control playback without being full admins. • /auth — grant playback control • /unauth — revoke it
help_blist: Blacklist commands Blacklisted chats and users can't touch the bot. • /blacklist [chat_id|user_id] • /unblacklist [chat_id|user_id]
help_lang: Language commands This bot speaks more than one language. • /lang — switch this chat's language
help_ping: General commands • /help — this menu • /ping — check latency & load • /start — wake me up • /sudolist — see the sudo team
help_play: Play commands Bring music into the video chat. • /play [name / link / reply to audio] • /vplay [name / link / reply to video] -f — force play now -v — play as video Example: /play -f -v attention • /autoplay [on/off] — keep the music going after the queue ends
help_stats: Stats commands • /stats — a look under the hood
help_sudo: Sudo commands • /ac — active calls count • /activevc — list active calls • /broadcast [reply] — message every chat -nochat — skip groups -user — include users -copy — drop the forwarded tag Example: /broadcast -user -copy • /eval — run a snippet • /logs — grab the log file • /logger [on|off] — toggle logging • /restart — restart the bot • /addsudo — add a sudo user • /rmsudo — remove a sudo user
